mentions.scope: Reaction charging was performed in an argon-filled glove box.
A 5.0 mL microreactor was charged with reagents and 1.0 mL dry THF; 5.0 mL is the stated vessel volume, not the reaction-mixture volume.
The microreactor was capped with this Teflon pressure cap; no operating pressure or pressure rating is stated.
The capped microreactor was placed into an aluminum block stated to be at 80 oC; this is the block temperature, not an explicitly measured reaction-mixture temperature.
THF was removed under reduced pressure; the evaporation apparatus is not identified.
